does: Checks text before it goes public in commits, pushes, tags, PRs, issues, reviews, releases, gists, discussions and other GitHub writes.

children.does: The public steps the gate checks.
Checks commit messages.
Checks the commits a push sends, read with git log -p.
Checks PR titles, bodies and comments.
Checks issues and issue comments.
Checks review comments.
Checks release titles, notes, asset labels and text assets.
Checks gist files and descriptions.
Checks the messages of annotated tags.
Checks discussion posts and comments.
Checks comments on commits.
Checks files written through the GitHub contents API.
Checks repo and label descriptions, and the fields of any other gh api write.
Stops a path into a home or temp folder.
Stops keys, tokens and chat session links, found by their shape.
Stops a word from the private words list.
Stops the host names of the machines in the profile.
Stops a public command whose text hub can not read, such as a variable, a pipe or a missing file.
Tells Claude to put the text in a file and pass the file.
Stops an em dash. In warn mode it stops a text only once.
Tells Claude how to rewrite a sentence without the dash.
Checks only repos the profile marks public.
Text the gate adds to its answer.
Tells Claude to fix the text and send the command again.
